text:
isabel: Heads-up: canary rollout for runtime 3.2.1 -> model=quant-v4b starts at 11:30 PT. Need final SDK compatibility sanity check before we unpin on canary. deploy-bot will run the gating compat tests.

deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout: `runtime=3.2.1` models=[quant-v4b] group=canary pct=5% — running preflight checks now.

sanjay: Quick q — does 3.2.1 include the KV-prefetch change that caused the longseq regressions last time?

elaine: yes, KV-prefetch is in. caveat: SDK 2.9 changed `session.init()` args (minor break) so we either need a shim or an SDK patch.

aditya: pushed a shim to `sdk-service` yesterday but didn't cut a release. Can we soft-unpin SDK on canary nodes (allow sdk_shim=true) so runtime can proceed?

mike: Recommend: keep dedicated pinned to 3.1.x for now. Allow canary to run 3.2.1 only if `sdk_shim=true`. Also add a compatibility gate command: `compat-check --model quant-v4b --runtime 3.2.1 --sdk 2.9`

isabel: Can someone run that compat-check and paste results here? If any regression >0.5% on our metrics (token-loss / generation mismatch) we abort and rollback.

deploy-bot: compat-check started: https://ci.redwood/compat/2770012345 (tests: basic, longseq, perf).

sanjay: Running locally, snippet:
```
[compat] latency P50 delta: +2ms
[compat] token-loss regressions: 0.12%
[compat] functional mismatches: 0
```
Looks good at surface level.

elaine: 0.12% < 0.5% threshold, but it's concentrated on long-sequence cases. flagging for QA.

aditya: Can we gate specifically on the longseq subset? If longseq token-loss >0.3% we should pin back immediately.

mike: +1 to gating on longseq. Also add fallback routing for long sequences so we don't impact customer traffic: `routing.policy.longseq = runtime:3.1.8`

isabel: I'll update rollout notes and set change window 11:30-13:00 PT. Abort conditions: error rate +0.5% or P95 latency +50ms -> immediate rollback to 3.1.8.

sanjay: I'll watch the logs and wire an alert on the longseq metric.

deploy-bot: canary stage: 5% -> 20% at 11:45 PT. SDK shim flag active on canary nodes.

elaine: :thumbsup:

aditya: Cutting `sdk-service` release v2.9.1 now (contains the shim). ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: sdk-service v2.9.1 deployed to canary.

isabel: QA run complete: longseq token-loss delta = 0.25%, overall <0.3%. Proceeding to ramp to 50% canary.

mike: Setting dedicated pin: `runtime_pin=3.1.8` until midnight to minimize risk for customers.

elaine: Note for release-notes: "Temporary compatibility shim between SDK 2.9.x and runtime 3.2.1 for `session.init` signature; mitigates long-sequence regressions during canary."

isabel: After ramp finishes, schedule a follow-up tomorrow to review perf deltas and decide whether to lift the dedicated pin.

aditya: If any customer regressions surface, enable immediate fallback routing and open a P1.

deploy-bot: canary ramp complete: 50% at 12:12 PT. No alerts triggered.

mike: I'll prepare the 100% rollout but keep dedicated pinned until tomorrow's review.

elaine: SGTM. I'll draft a short blurb for #release-notes and ops channel summarizing the gating and the shim.

isabel: Thanks all — keeping this thread as single source of truth. Will post rollback details here if we trigger abort.

aditya: copy.

deploy-bot: thread closed by isabel (rollout in progress, monitors green)."
